name: POV
description: Point-of-view storytelling that puts the viewer in a relatable scenario
example: POV: Your resume gets rejected before HR even opens it

name: Expectation vs Reality
description: Split comparison between what we imagine vs what actually happens
example: Expectation: Landing dream job. Reality: Rejection email at 2am

name: Nobody
description: Nobody: ... / Me: ... format highlighting unexpected or relatable behavior
best_for: unexpected behavior, niche humor, personality quirks
example: Nobody: / Me at 3am: Rebuilding my resume for the 10th time

name: Honest Ad
description: Brutally honest product pitch that subverts traditional advertising
example: We literally just make your resume not look like a Google Doc disaster

name: Transformation
description: Before-and-after story arc showing product impact
example: Before: 0 callbacks. After using AI Resume Builder: 5 interviews this week

name: Stitching Facts
description: Drop a surprising or counterintuitive fact to hook attention
example: 75% of resumes are rejected by ATS before a human ever reads them

name: Day in the Life
description: Follow a character through their routine, naturally integrating the product
example: Day in the life of someone who actually gets callbacks

name: Duet / Reply
description: Respond to a common question or pain point your audience has
example: Replying to: 'Why do I never get interview calls?'

name: Storytime
description: First-person story with a hook, conflict, and resolution
example: Story time: The day I sent 100 resumes and got zero replies

name: Green Screen React
description: React to real content (screenshots, articles) with commentary
example: Reacting to a LinkedIn post about ATS rejection rates
